Reason for Mistake: In the final step (Step 4), the Planner incorrectly interpreted the search results for "Ghar Ki Rani". The search results clearly indicated a 1940 film and a 1945 film. Instead of accepting the 1940/1945 dates which are historically accurate for the famous Bollywood film, the Planner hallucinated a "canonical year" of 2007 based on a misreading of an IMDb "Release Info" page (which likely listed a 2007 re-release or digital entry, not the original film). This led to the false conclusion that Ghar Ki Rani (2007) was released after Heaven Help Us (1985), whereas the correct answer is that Ghar Ki Rani (1940) was released first.
